description: Written-terminator priority is a local commitment. On A B T, r could leave out [T] and read the token as its last T. But the prefix of r before c can read c and then T as the optional, so the omission is forbidden, and begins of r is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text A B T
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r A c [+T] T
%rule c B
